items.title: Director Total Rewards for LKQ Europe
items.summary: Director Total Rewards for LKQ Europe Izabela Wed, 08/20/2025 - 10:53 EMPLOYEE STORIES Christin Olejak Director Total Rewards for LKQ Europe Meet our Director Total Rewards for LKQ Europe Christin Olejak Ten years ago, I began my journey with LKQ DACH and it’s been an exciting, meaningful, and transformative ride ever since. I’ve always been passionate about Human Resources: helping people grow, shaping workplace culture, and creating a real impact. LKQ has given me the opportunity to take my passion to a European level. I thrive in multicultural environments and truly believe that we are stronger when we bring our unique perspectives together. So far, I’ve had the privilege of contributing to impactful initiatives that promote diversity, inclusion, and a workplace where people feel engaged and motivated. But what truly makes this journey special are the colleagues I work with - collaborative, inspiring, and genuinely great people. Currently, I lead our European Total Rewards efforts, with a strong focus on recognition and advancing our journey toward pay transparency. This is a topic very close to my heart, because I believe everyone deserves to be seen, heard, and valued, including through financial empowerment. That means creating real opportunities for women and for everyone. ‘Keeping you moving is more than just a mantra - it’s what drives me every day to grow, connect, and make a difference.’ Christin Olejak Director Total Rewards for LKQ Europe

items.title: Valeria Ambrese Head legal and compliance LKQ RHIAG Italy
items.summary: Valeria Ambrese Head legal and compliance LKQ RHIAG Italy admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 19:37 EMPLOYEE STORIES Valeria Ambrese Head of Legal and Compliance at LKQ RHIAG Italy Meet our Head of Legal and Compliance at LKQ RHIAG Italy Valeria Ambrese LKQ has been a great platform for me to grow. I was the first in-house legal counsel at LKQ RHIAG Italy in January 2021 – an opportunity that allowed me to challenge myself as I established and managed a function, taking our legal and compliance capabilities from strength to strength. No two days are the same. Even though I have similar daily routines, the people and projects I work with, and involved in, vary greatly. My team and I are here to make sure the way of working is conducted both correctly and legally within the organization in order to avoid potential risks to our company. I am now working as part of the central function, this gives me the opportunity to meet and talk to my colleagues across Europe which is fantastic, as despite the differences between our culture, languages, and legislations, we have the same goal to share best practices and create stronger, profitable and inclusive organizations. Lawyers are not enemies to businesses, but the windshield of an organization. items.title: Jareau Mantel Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France
items.summary: Jareau Mantel Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 13:37 EMPLOYEE STORIES Jareau Mantel Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France Meet our Communication Manager at LKQ Benelux-France I’m lucky enough to have experienced both sides of communication – in my professional life. Before joining LKQ Europe, I was sometimes on the receiving end. So, I know how frustrating it can be when communication doesn’t make any sense and you can’t relate to it. But because I’ve been there, I now know how to avoid this type of confusion. The solution sounds simple – step away from your desk and get a fresh perspective. In my case, go to other departments or warehouses to talk to people. These valuable conversations are an insightful two-way street that lets me find out if what I’m doing is relatable. As part of our exchange, I can find out if people understand the intended message and the way it’s presented. It’s what I love most about my role – in communications, the learning curve never ends. Valuable conversations are an insightful two-way street that lets me find out if what I’m doing is relatable. items.title: Carolina Zucco Product Manager LKQ RHIAG Italy
items.summary: Carolina Zucco Product Manager LKQ RHIAG Italy admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 13:31 EMPLOYEE STORIES Carolina Zucco Product Manager LKQ RHIAG Italy Meet our Product Manager LKQ RHIAG Italy Carolina Zucco In my job, I drive two very different roads at the same time. By doing this, I’m building connections between the branch operators and suppliers. The product categories I’m responsible for represent a mix of what LKQ is all about – one part heritage and experience, but also leading innovation and looking to the future. I’m able to see some products from the initial stages to selling – in addition to gaining insight into trade, supply chain and customer service elements in between. So it’s important that I remain agile and efficient to quickly analyze and map the market, and understand customer trends and behaviours. I’m committed to making a difference on both a strategic and operational level. And I’m glad that I can feel proud about the projects I work on, which contribute to creating a more unified company, while keeping the unique strengths of our regions. Together, we are stronger. The product categories I’m responsible for represent a mix of what LKQ is all about – one part heritage and experience, but also leading innovation and looking to the future. items.title: Kjire Panovski Logistics LKQ RHIAG Switzerland
items.summary: Kjire Panovski Logistics LKQ RHIAG Switzerland admin Mon, 06/24/2024 - 13:27 EMPLOYEE STORIES Kjire Panovski Logistics LKQ RHIAG Switzerland Meet our Logistics Employee LKQ RHIAG Switzerland Kjire Panovski I have always wanted to become a forklift truck driver, and this year thanks to LKQ DACH, I will be able to make my professional goal come true, as I have been selected for further development training along with a few other colleagues from my company. Currently I am working in the logistics department, I take care of receipting of goods and returns from our customers. What keeps me motivated daily, is not only that I like and understand our business very well, but also the excellent communication and relationship with the team – both during working hours, but also outside of work, where we sometimes spend time together playing darts and pool. To me, being able to grow in a place where I dedicate my time is very important. And with LKQ I feel we can grow together. LKQ RHIAG Switzerland helps me further develop my working skills.
